profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a public company founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, WA, trading as MSFT, with CIK 0000789019. Its most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2026-06-30, reporting revenue of 331839000000 U.S. dollars. The company site page supplied here covers Power Automate, which Microsoft describes as a way to automate workflows and business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI, digital, and robotic process automation. The page also carries customer statements about using generative AI and Power Automate, including one saying a data validation and standardization process that once took over 100 people can now be managed by a few.

The tracked products span several areas. Microsoft Copilot is embedded across M365, and Azure OpenAI Service and Azure Machine Learning cover cloud model access and MLOps. Microsoft Power Automate AI covers enterprise workflow automation with Copilot integration, M365 data access, and DLP integration. Developer tools include AutoGen, a multi-agent conversation framework from Microsoft Research, Semantic Kernel, a model-agnostic orchestration SDK for .NET, Python, and Java, and Microsoft Agent Framework, described as the successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen with a unified .NET and Python agent SDK, graph workflows, and native MCP and A2A support. Other products listed are Microsoft Designer, Microsoft Teams AI, SharePoint AI, and Microsoft Clipchamp AI.

Two cases are recorded in the U.S. District Court, S.D. New York: The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. Litigation exposure is also noted in Washington, with a count of 114.
